relationships.rationale: Terminal command tokens require the fixture-exclusion boundary to prevent mock handlers from being treated as production wiring; the command binding and acceptance-evidence boundary remain distinct.
Terminal navigation chips and clickable info icons share keyboard and role obligations, but they are separate controls with separate interaction promises.
Terminal restore outcomes interact with detached-surface eligibility, while surface-class eligibility remains a separate decision boundary from the terminal restore state machine.
Terminal restore depends on terminal lifecycle and requested-versus-effective freshness truth, but restore capability and ongoing terminal lifecycle remain distinct contracts.
The autonomous verification suite depends on the production-readiness gate that requires accessibility evidence; verification-suite behavior and accessibility evidence scope remain distinct.
Accessibility evidence can only certify the command-control accessibility contract; the evidence gate is not synonymous with the product contract it checks.
The first-run onboarding controls depend on the generic UI-command accessibility and localization contract, while onboarding retains its own state machine and recovery lifecycle.
Long-thread jump, search, and anchor restoration depend on stable-ID virtualization and height-cache behavior, but navigation state and rendering performance are distinct lifecycles.
The nonce-bound incremental stream bridge extends the inline visualizer surface, while bridge transport and widget taxonomy remain distinct responsibilities.
Destructive memory maintenance needs an executable operation protocol for progress, cancellation, failure, and recovery, but maintenance safety policy is distinct from invocation mechanics.
The seeded widget-composed Usage page extends the canonical Usage dashboard placement, while default composition and cross-surface placement remain distinct promises.
Usage widget layout and accessible interaction shape the canonical Usage dashboard, but widget interaction state is not synonymous with dashboard placement and routing.
ResearchProgressCard is one operation-card kind whose lifecycle must remain consistent with the containing card state and result, while the global card invariant applies to additional card kinds.
Denied-card invalid fixtures exercise denial metadata, while expected diagnostic outcomes are a separate fixture-runner contract rather than part of the denial card itself.
Provider registry status presentation interacts with projection-fixture consumer mapping, but registry-row GUI truth and projection-generation lifecycle have separate authorities and failure modes.
